name: temp_sensor
description: temp_sensor: the sensor for 10-50 degC (ESP-IDF picks its DAC offset 0) read once a second; the room at 25 degC reads 104, 0.4386 x 104 - 20.52 = 25.09 degC, which ESP-IDF's temp_sensor_get_raw_value returns as an int: 25. The eFuses hold no calibration (BLOCK2 blank), so the driver warns and applies none.
